Hi @DaveCTurner , I have updated the PR. Here are the related logics:

If cluster has read only blocks and archived settings:
1. Cannot remove read only blocks due to archived settings.
2. Cannot update any cluster settings due to read only blocks.
3. Can only remove archived settings.

That means we cannot do any changes before removing archived settings. And if cluster is read only, except removing archived settings, we could do nothing include removing read only blocks.

Now we also support removing transient and persistent cluster blocks together.
